'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Shawn Banwell LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Shawn Banwell]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Informal sheet. Careful Planning (V) start with Anger, Fear, Aggression (V).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Shawn Banwell]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Careful Planning (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
